plan.planSummary: S22 builds Project Seraphim's deterministic-first, Claude-augmented name-matching backbone for all non-face attendance sources. Core deliverable is backend/app/services/name_match.py: a pure-library 4-stage pipeline (normalize -> alias dictionary -> deterministic jellyfish jaro-winkler fuzzy with Filipino surname-first-3 + reversed-name awareness -> claude-sonnet-4-6 LLM fallback -> human review queue) with FROZEN public signatures consumed by S06/S10/S13/S18. Three new ORM models (NameAlias, NameMatchReviewQueue, CommunityReport) land in ONE Alembic migration whose down_revision is the verified current head a2b3c4d5e6f7, created in CN-22 FK order (name_alias -> community_report -> name_match_review_queue). Four router groups expose intake (POST /attendance/name-list reusing S05 bulk insert), review-queue resolve/unmatch/skip/reprocess-aliases, name-alias CRUD+teach, and community-report submit/list/detail/process. Frontend adds a review-queue page with resolve modal (teach-alias), a single-page community-report form (event/attendees/qualitative/photos), a reports list+detail, and an Event-detail name-list panel. The Claude client is wrapped behind an injectable function with a deterministic stub path (no API key OR ENVIRONMENT==test OR admin_settings name_match.claude_enabled=false -> return None), so pytest NEVER makes a live LLM call; the 'ID 1 if unsure' n8n anti-pattern is replaced everywhere by enqueueing unmatched names to the review queue. Stack conventions enforced: async/await throughout, type hints on public fns, JSON().with_variant(JSONB,'postgresql'), no /api prefix, dual-dialect ON CONFLICT, Tailwind tokens only, sonner toasts, loading/error/empty states.

featureTasks.name: S22-F01: ORM models + single Alembic migration (NameAlias, NameMatchReviewQueue, CommunityReport)
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria: Three model classes added to backend/app/models.py exactly per spec sec3.1-3.3 (columns, FK ondelete, JSONB defaults via the models.py:26 JSONB alias, utc_now timestamps, named indexes). ONE migration file backend/alembic/versions/<rev>_s22_name_matching_tables.py with down_revision='a2b3c4d5e6f7' (the verified current alembic head) creating tables in CN-22 order: (1) name_alias, (2) community_report, (3) name_match_review_queue (which FKs community_report.id). Downgrade drops in exact reverse order. `alembic upgrade head` runs clean on SQLite (test path, create_all mirrors __table_args__) and is valid for Postgres; `alembic downgrade -1` removes all three. UNIQUE(alias_text) named uq_name_alias_text; all spec indexes present. A code comment in the migration confirms participants.source value 'community_report' needs no DDL (String(30), CN-07).
featureTasks.engineerNotes: down_revision MUST be 'a2b3c4d5e6f7' — verified via `alembic heads`; the task-prompt's stated head matches the actual tip (a2b3c4d5e6f7_s05_export_jobs, whose own down_revision is j4k5l6m7n8o9). Do NOT invent a revision id (CN-26); pick a fresh unique rev string. Use module-level JSONB alias already at models.py:26 — do not re-import. date_of_activity uses DateTime (not Date) per spec note matching existing utc_now pattern; CommunityReportCreate accepts a `date` and the handler coerces to datetime. Mirror every Index/UniqueConstraint in __table_args__ so SQLite create_all (conftest) produces an identical schema. FK ondelete: name_alias.contact_id CASCADE, created_by_id SET NULL; all NMRQ + community_report contact/event/user FKs SET NULL as specified. NameMatchReviewQueue.community_report_id -> community_report.id forces the create order.

featureTasks.name: S22-F02: name_match.py service — 4-stage pipeline + injectable Claude wrapper (FROZEN public API)
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria: New backend/app/services/name_match.py exporting the FROZEN public API: normalize_name(raw)->str (pure, not async); async lookup_alias(normalized, db)->Optional[MatchCandidate]; async lookup_deterministic(normalized, db, min_score=0.88)->list[MatchCandidate]; async lookup_claude(raw_name, normalized, candidates, db)->Optional[MatchCandidate]; async match_name(raw_name, db, source, event_id=None, community_report_id=None, payload=None, auto_enqueue=True)->NameMatchResult; async match_name_batch(names, db, source, event_id=None, community_report_id=None)->list[NameMatchResult]; async teach_alias_from_resolution(db, review_queue_id, contact_id, alias_text=None, actor_id=None)->NameAlias. normalize_name passes ALL spec sec4.2.2 vectors (Ptr. Rodel Aquino Jr.->rodel aquino; EVANGELISTA, Guada->evangelista guada; Tita Cely->cely; Marichu P.->marichu; Nino diacritic; honorific list tita/kuya/ate/bro/sis/pastor/ptr/rev/dtr/dr/mr/mrs/ms/sir/ma). Deterministic stage uses jellyfish.jaro_winkler_similarity (NOT difflib), surname-first-3 LIKE prefix query (<=200 rows), scores forward+reversed+nickname, applies sec4.2.3 ambiguity rules. Pipeline order is alias(stage3)-first then fuzzy then claude, never silently returns contact 1. Module imports only app.models + jellyfish + anthropic + sqlalchemy.async (NO router imports) — verified by a no-circular-import test. Stage order, signatures, and TypedDicts are documented as a FROZEN contract in the module docstring.
featureTasks.engineerNotes: CLAUDE CLIENT WRAPPER (critical): expose an injectable factory, e.g. module-level `_claude_client_factory` defaulting to a function that returns anthropic.AsyncAnthropic(), plus a `set_claude_client_factory(fn)` hook so tests inject a fake. lookup_claude FIRST checks the stub gate and returns None without constructing any client when ANY of: os.environ.get('ENVIRONMENT')=='test', OR ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset/empty, OR dynamic_settings.get_bool('name_match.claude_enabled', False) is False. Model id is claude-sonnet-4-6 (PER TASK CONSTRAINT — overrides the spec body's claude-haiku-3-5 and master's claude-haiku-3-5; the spec/master used haiku for cost, but the sprint constraint mandates sonnet-4-6 for the matching agent). Configurable via dynamic_settings.get_str('name_match.claude_model','claude-sonnet-4-6'). Call shape (Python SDK, verified via claude-api skill): client.messages.create(model=..., max_tokens=256, messages=[{role:'user',content:PROMPT}]); parse JSON from response.content[0].text; validate returned contact_id is in the candidates list (reject hallucinations -> fall through to queue); module-level asyncio.Semaphore(5). On anthropic.APIError/APIStatusError: log warning, return None (never raise to caller). Prompt is the sec4.2.5 Filipino-localized template with the 'NEVER return a contact_id not in candidates / NEVER guess / null is correct' rules. MatchCandidate/NameMatchResult are TypedDicts per sec4.2.1. CONTRACT NOTE for QA/architect: master sec2.6 lists a narrower frozen signature `match_name(raw_name, event_id=None, source='manual')` with MatchResult.outcome in SINGLE|AMBIGUOUS|UNMATCHED, while spec sec4.3/4.2.6 uses the richer db-passing signature returning NameMatchResult. The spec's richer signature is authoritative for S22 (consumers S06/S10/S13/S18 pass db); keep params keyword-compatible (raw_name, db, source, event_id) and document the reconciliation so master can be patched. teach_alias_from_resolution upserts name_alias ON CONFLICT(alias_text) DO UPDATE SET contact_id (dual-dialect, like bulk_service _dialect()).

featureTasks.name: S22-F04: POST /attendance/name-list intake endpoint (reuse S05 bulk insert)
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria: POST /attendance/name-list added to backend/app/routers/attendance.py, require_volunteer, registered under existing attendance router (already has check_setup_complete). Validates event exists+is_active (404/400), optional community_report_id status in (submitted,pending), clamps len<=500 (422 over). For <=50 names runs match_name_batch synchronously incl. Claude; for >50 runs alias+deterministic sync, dispatches Claude via asyncio.create_task and returns claude_pending=true. Matched results -> Participant rows (source=source, status='attended', event_id) inserted via the S05 dual-dialect ON CONFLICT(event_id,contact_id) DO NOTHING pattern (reuse bulk_service or replicate its insert idiom); skipped_existing counted via pre/post or RETURNING. Unmatched already enqueued by match_name(auto_enqueue=True). Emits audit_svc.record(action='attendance.name_list_intake', entity='event', entity_id=event_id, after={matched,queued,skipped}). Returns NameListIntakeResponse where matched+skipped_existing+review_queue==total. Idempotent: same name twice => matched=1 then matched=0,skipped_existing=1.
featureTasks.engineerNotes: Reuse app.services.bulk_service for the set-based insert: either call a thin helper or replicate the pg_insert/sqlite_insert + on_conflict_do_nothing(index_elements=['event_id','contact_id']) idiom already in bulk_service (uses app.database.engine dialect). Import match_name_batch from app.services.name_match. Factor the actual matching+insert into an internal async function (e.g. process_name_list(db, event_id, names, source, community_report_id, caller_id)) so S22-F06 community-report POST can call it directly WITHOUT an HTTP round-trip (spec sec4.5 step5). featureTasks.name: S22-F05: Review-queue + name-alias routers (resolve/unmatch/skip/reprocess + alias CRUD/teach)
featureTasks.acceptanceCriteria: New backend/app/routers/name_match.py (prefix /name-match): GET /review-queue (paginated, filters status/source/event_id, newest-first, page_size clamp<=100, joins event_title/resolved_contact_name); POST /review-queue/{id}/resolve (sec4.6: 404 if missing, validate contact not deleted, 409 if already matched/unmatched, set resolved_*+status='matched', insert participant ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING if event_id present, optional teach_alias upsert, audit name_match.resolved); POST /review-queue/{id}/unmatch ({reason?}); POST /review-queue/{id}/skip ({} leaves pending); POST /review-queue/reprocess-aliases (admin, re-runs alias+claude on pending, auto-resolves high-confidence creating participant + status='matched' resolved_by_id=None, returns {processed,auto_matched,still_pending}). New backend/app/routers/name_aliases.py (prefix /name-aliases): GET (admin, search+paginate), POST (admin create, normalize before store), POST /teach (volunteer, from review item -> teach_alias_from_resolution), PATCH /{id} (admin swap contact), DELETE /{id} (admin 204). patchTasks.name: S22-P03: Confirm Claude model id constraint (sonnet-4-6 vs spec/master haiku-3-5)
patchTasks.goal: Record that the matching agent uses claude-sonnet-4-6 (per sprint CRITICAL CONSTRAINT) and is configurable via admin_settings name_match.claude_model; spec sec4.2.5/sec10.3 and master both reference claude-haiku-3-5 for cost — the sprint constraint overrides, default is sonnet-4-6. Surface to owner as the post-launch cost/accuracy knob (open question sec10.3).

plan.risks: 1) FROZEN signature conflict: spec sec4.3 (db-passing, NameMatchResult) vs master sec2.6 (no-db, MatchResult.outcome). Chose spec form as authoritative for S22 and flagged master patch (P02) — if downstream sprints already coded against master's form, they break at import; mitigated because all are sequenced after S22. 2) Live-LLM-in-tests is the highest-risk failure mode: stub gate must trigger on ALL THREE of ENVIRONMENT==test / missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / admin_settings name_match.claude_enabled=false, the AsyncAnthropic client must be lazily constructed only inside lookup_claude after the gate, and conftest must add the disable row + a monkeypatch guard asserting no construction (spec AC14). 3) Migration ordering (CN-22) is load-bearing — name_match_review_queue FKs community_report so reversing creation order errors; downgrade must mirror. down_revision is a2b3c4d5e6f7 (verified head); using any spec-illustrative id (CN-26) would break the chain. 4) Dual-dialect ON CONFLICT: SQLite (tests) and Postgres need branched insert idioms — reuse bulk_service._dialect()+pg_insert/sqlite_insert rather than reimplementing. 5) Model id: sonnet-4-6 ($3/$15 per MTok) is materially pricier per call than the spec's haiku — acceptable per constraint but call out as the owner cost lever. 6) Filipino normalize edge cases (honorific-as-prefix only when followed by space; single-char-word removal vs legit one-letter surnames) — exhaustively covered by the sec8.1 vector tests. 7) Frontend reuse risks: ContactPickerModal/StorageUpload/StateViews exact paths must be verified by reading current files before import; EventDetailPage edit must stay additive to avoid S04 regression. 8) >50-name async Claude path uses asyncio.create_task within request scope (no S16 scheduler yet) — ensure it doesn't hold the request's db session after response; spec accepts claude_pending=true + UI re-fetch.

recon.stack: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 async (Mapped/mapped_column) + Alembic + asyncpg(prod)/aiosqlite(tests); Pydantic v2 (ConfigDict, Literal, model_validator); React 18 + TS + Vite + Tailwind + TanStack Query + Zustand + sonner; Redis (slowapi/SSE/JTI); no /api prefix (nginx strips). New libs: jellyfish>=0.12.0 (jaro_winkler_similarity), anthropic>=0.40.0 (AsyncAnthropic, claude-sonnet-4-6).
